cases.background: Indoor and brief outdoor scenes show two women interacting in domestic settings, often near potted plants or kitchen areas, with recurring attire including striped shirts and patterned cardigans. One woman with curly blonde hair and a necklace appears frequently, sometimes speaking or gesturing. Backgrounds include framed pictures, wallpaper, and cabinets. The BBC logo appears in several frames, suggesting broadcast context. One frame transitions to an outdoor blur, and another shows animated digital elements, indicating a possible shift in content or interface. Unclear whether scenes are continuous or edited.

A series of short video windows shows snowplows operating in snowy environments under clear or partly cloudy skies. Vehicles, mostly black or dark green with orange plows, clear roads by pushing or ejecting snow, forming piles along the sides. Some frames show smoke from exhausts, and one includes a visible person inside a cab. One vehicle is stationary, another appears military-style. Snow covers the ground, and sky conditions vary slightly. No consistent human activity outside vehicles is observed. Unclear whether all vehicles are part of the same operation or location.

A hand with various nail art styles is shown across multiple frames, performing or posing for close-up views of nail decoration, including glitter tips, gradient designs, and brush applications of polish or clear sealant. Backgrounds are mostly plain and light-colored, with occasional pink floral elements or watermark text. Some frames show tools like brushes or sponges in use, while others display tutorial-style split screens with text overlays. Two frames are entirely black, offering no visual context. No consistent narrative or environmental continuity is established across the sequence.

limitations: Labels used only for posthoc diagnosis, not new predictions; negatives are native relative labels, not proof of no semantic value. Single-token probabilities do not reveal causal rule use.
